_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Taproot#001.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の {p} で Lari を見つける

Taproot#002.src: ...oh. {u}, you're back. Ehm...I have to say, I'm...rather busy at the moment.
Taproot#002.dst: …あ。{u}、戻ったのね。ええと…正直、今は…ちょっと忙しいの。
Taproot#002.speaker: Lari

Taproot#003.src: I have...important things to do. This accursed Decay...I have to end it. This all needs to stop.
Taproot#003.dst: やるべき…大事なことがあるの。この忌まわしい腐朽を…終わらせなきゃ。全部止めないと。
Taproot#003.speaker: Lari

Taproot#004.src: I am thankful for your aid with the...the Grootslang, but I do not believe you will be able to help with this- Simply a matter of scale.
Taproot#004.dst: Grootslang の…件では助かったわ。でも今回はあなたには無理だと思う。単に規模の問題よ。
Taproot#004.speaker: Lari

Taproot#005.src: I apologize, but I need to focus on my task here. If, perhaps, you could come back another time? And, I do mean that sincerely...
Taproot#005.dst: ごめんなさい、今はここの仕事に集中したいの。また今度来てもらえる？本当に、心からそう思ってるの…
Taproot#005.speaker: Lari

Taproot#006.src: I can't even recall how many attempts this will make...but all my knowledge has gone into this. This must work.
Taproot#006.dst: もう何度目の挑戦かも思い出せない…でも知識は全部つぎ込んだ。今度こそ成功させないと。
Taproot#006.speaker: Lari

Taproot#007.src: Follow Lari to the black spot next to her camp.
Taproot#007.dst: Lari について野営地の横の黒い染みへ行く。

Taproot#008.src: ...I suppose I can't fault you for being curious. You may have seen a large, dark-looking patch of ground on your way here- I am trying to tend to it once more.
Taproot#008.dst: …気になるのも無理ないわね。来る途中、大きく黒ずんだ地面を見たかもしれない。もう一度そこを癒やそうとしているの。
Taproot#008.speaker: Lari

Taproot#009.src: It is...the most obvious stain of the decay, and very intense...if I can scrub this out, the rest should follow.
Taproot#009.dst: あれは…腐朽の一番目立つ染みで、とても濃い…あそこを清められれば、他も良くなるはず。
Taproot#009.speaker: Lari

Taproot#010.src: This concoction of mine should...do the trick!
Taproot#010.dst: 私の調合したこの薬なら…きっと効く！
Taproot#010.speaker: Lari

Taproot#011.src: It...it's working!! I can feel it, the land is reacting positively!
Taproot#011.dst: き…効いてる！！感じるわ、大地が良い反応をしてる！
Taproot#011.speaker: Lari

Taproot#012.src: I...I... It was...it was working, a-and... Agh, why can't I get this RIGHT?!
Taproot#012.dst: わ…私… 効いてたのに、そ、それで… ああ、どうしてうまくいかないの？！
Taproot#012.speaker: Lari

Taproot#013.src: How many decades have I been doing this? How much time have I wasted, just...flailing like this?!
Taproot#013.dst: 何十年これを続けてきたの？どれだけの時間を…こうしてもがくだけで無駄にしたの？！
Taproot#013.speaker: Lari

Taproot#014.src: Look, {u}, I...I don't know what you expect to do against this. The Wyrm was one thing, but...this is beyond your comprehension.
Taproot#014.dst: ねえ、{u}、あなたがこれに何をするつもりか…分からない。Wyrm とはわけが違う…これはあなたの理解を超えてるの。
Taproot#014.speaker: Lari

Taproot#015.src: I think you sh... Should...w-what is... Now, of all times? As I fail?!
Taproot#015.dst: あなたはも… もう…な、何…？よりによって今？失敗した時に？！
Taproot#015.speaker: Lari

Taproot#016.src: The road, look! He's contacting me! A-are you finally giving me the answers I've asked for?
Taproot#016.dst: 道よ、見て！あの方が呼びかけてる！つ、ついに求めてきた答えをくださるの？
Taproot#016.speaker: Lari

Taproot#017.src: Follow the trail of magic leading from the black spot.
Taproot#017.dst: 黒い染みから伸びる魔法の跡をたどる。

Taproot#018.src: Talk to Lari outside the weird gate at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Taproot#018.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の奇妙な門の外で Lari と話す

Taproot#019.src: ...I followed you seeking answers...and here, I am presented with more questions. Why did he bring us here?
Taproot#019.dst: …答えを求めてついてきたのに…ここで増えたのは疑問ばかり。どうしてあの方は私たちをここへ？
Taproot#019.speaker: Lari

Taproot#020.src: This gate has appeared, immovable and impassable, since the moment that...that everything started.
Taproot#020.dst: この門は…すべてが始まったその時から現れて、動かせず、通れないの。
Taproot#020.speaker: Lari

Taproot#021.src: I don't...is he trying to remind me of what's at stake? Did he want to show y- No, that's...he wouldn't know you...but then, what IS this about?!
Taproot#021.dst: わからない…何が懸かっているか思い出させたいの？あなたに見せ…いえ、あの方があなたを知るはずない…なら、これは何なの？！
Taproot#021.speaker: Lari

Taproot#022.src: Rrgh... ANSWER ME! PLEASE! I've begged you for so long to answer!
Taproot#022.dst: うう…答えて！お願い！ずっと答えてと願ってきたのに！
Taproot#022.speaker: Lari

Taproot#023.src: You gave me my task and your light but never told me what to DO! I've tried everything I can think of!!
Taproot#023.dst: 使命と光をくださったのに、何を「する」かは教えてくれなかった！思いつくことは全部試したのに！！
Taproot#023.speaker: Lari

Taproot#024.src: Tell me! Please, just t-tell me already!! I don't know how much longer I can stand this!!
Taproot#024.dst: 教えて！お願い、もう教えてよ！！これ以上耐えられるか分からない！！
Taproot#024.speaker: Lari

Taproot#025.src: I...a-another one? Where are you leading me now?
Taproot#025.dst: え…ま、また？今度はどこへ導くの？
Taproot#025.speaker: Lari

Taproot#026.src: It...the gateway...? Are you...I can't understand! Why this, again?
Taproot#026.dst: これ…門…？あなたは…わからない！どうしてまたこれを？
Taproot#026.speaker: Lari

Taproot#027.src: You showed me this before... At first, when you first contacted me. I made the choice...
Taproot#027.dst: 前にもこれを見せてくれた…最初、初めて呼びかけてくれた時に。私は選択をした…
Taproot#027.speaker: Lari

Taproot#028.src: Must I make it again? Is that it, do I need to prove myself to you once more?
Taproot#028.dst: もう一度選べというの？また自分を証明しなきゃいけないの？
Taproot#028.speaker: Lari

Taproot#029.src: I...what? You...you present me with this, but refuse to let me do what you want?
Taproot#029.dst: え…何？これを見せておいて、望むことをさせてくれないの？
Taproot#029.speaker: Lari

Taproot#030.src: ...please, can you investigate the doorway? There must be something wrong that I don't understand.
Taproot#030.dst: …お願い、あの扉を調べてくれない？私には分からない何かがおかしいはず。
Taproot#030.speaker: Lari

Taproot#033.src: My pulse... Human. I must inquire to you. I present you a test. Guide your attention to those you see.
Taproot#033.dst: 我が脈動よ…人間よ。問わねばならぬ。試練を与えよう。目に映る者たちに注意を向けよ。

Taproot#034.src: I must see the rhythm your heart beats. Listen well.
Taproot#034.dst: お前の心臓が刻む律動を見ねばならぬ。よく聞け。

Taproot#035.src: This has gone far enough. I can't do this anymore! I can't give you any more and I refuse to apologize for it!
Taproot#035.dst: もう限界だ。これ以上は無理だ！もう何も差し出せないし、それを謝るつもりもない！
Taproot#035.speaker: Mayor

Taproot#036.src: You know our deal. Remember what good you are doing by following the plans I've laid out for you.
Taproot#036.dst: 我々の取り決めは分かっているだろう。私の敷いた計画に従えば、どれほどの善をなしているか思い出したまえ。
Taproot#036.speaker: Dr. Urelix

Taproot#037.src: Are you going to let your emotions cloud your judgment? You're a smarter man than that, Mr. Mayor.
Taproot#037.dst: 感情で判断を曇らせるつもりかね？君はそれほど愚かではないはずだ、市長殿。
Taproot#037.speaker: Dr. Urelix

Taproot#038.src: You can't possibly believe that throwing away the lives of innocent people is right! I can't go on with this on my conscience!
Taproot#038.dst: 罪なき人々の命を捨てるのが正しいなど、本気で思えるはずがない！こんな良心の呵責を抱えては続けられない！
Taproot#038.speaker: Mayor

Taproot#039.src: Detective Hart WILL be hearing from me, and he'll be hearing everything. We can't keep sacrificing our own like this!
Taproot#039.dst: Hart 探偵に「必ず」話す、それも洗いざらいな。こんな風に身内を犠牲にし続けるわけにはいかん！
Taproot#039.speaker: Mayor

Taproot#040.src: Our golems have single-handedly turned the tide of the Humans' corruption war. You would save ten here and sentence a thousand to die overseas?
Taproot#040.dst: 我々のゴーレムは、人間の腐敗との戦争の流れを独力で変えたのだ。ここで十人救って、海の向こうの千人を死なせるのかね？
Taproot#040.speaker: Dr. Urelix

Taproot#041.src: You're a sick, twisted man, Urelix. I will not abide by this a moment longer.
Taproot#041.dst: Urelix、お前は病んだ歪んだ男だ。もう一瞬たりとも従わんぞ。
Taproot#041.speaker: Mayor

Taproot#042.src: My pulse, you must decide. Three paths diverge upon your road.
Taproot#042.dst: 我が脈動よ、決めねばならぬ。お前の道は三つに分かれる。

Taproot#043.src: You may leave. The rays of fate will see to destiny unfolding.
Taproot#043.dst: 去ってもよい。運命の光が、定めの成り行きを見届けよう。

Taproot#044.src: You may end this "Mayor's" life. Blood upon your hands in many ways.
Taproot#044.dst: この「市長」の命を絶ってもよい。その手は幾重にも血に染まろう。

Taproot#046.src: You may end the life of Urelix. Heartbeats ceased by a bleeding heart.
Taproot#046.dst: Urelix の命を絶ってもよい。情けに血を流す心が、鼓動を止めるのだ。

Taproot#047.src: Which way does your heart beat? How will you cast your light? Can you see?
Taproot#047.dst: お前の心臓はどちらへ鼓動する？光をどう投げかける？見えるか？

Taproot#049.src: My pulse... The blood of a bleeding heart has poisoned me. Even if you believe the sun should shine elsewhere, you must direct it yourself.
Taproot#049.dst: 我が脈動よ…血を流す心の血が、私を蝕んだ。太陽は別の所を照らすべきと思おうとも、お前自身の手で導かねばならぬ。

Taproot#050.src: You must realize what is needed. You must see light through my lens.
Taproot#050.dst: 何が必要か悟らねばならぬ。我がレンズを通して光を見よ。

Taproot#051.src: To leave... As destiny unfolds, the sun shall set.
Taproot#051.dst: 去るならば…定めが展開し、日は沈むであろう。

Taproot#052.src: To end this Mayor's life... To snuff out one whose heart aches is painful.
Taproot#052.dst: この市長の命を絶つならば…痛む心を消すのは辛きことだ。

Taproot#053.src: To end the life of Urelix... The shadows of war shall engulf all.
Taproot#053.dst: Urelix の命を絶つならば…戦の影がすべてを呑み込もう。

Taproot#054.src: My pulse, there is only one choice. You must do what is required, I beg of you.
Taproot#054.dst: 我が脈動よ、選択は一つのみ。なすべきことをなせ、頼む。

Taproot#055.src: Ah, you recognize necessity. That couldn't have been pleasant...but what's needed isn't pleasant, in the end.
Taproot#055.dst: ああ、必要性を理解したか。愉快ではなかったろう…だが結局、必要なことは愉快ではないものだ。
Taproot#055.speaker: Dr. Urelix

Taproot#056.dst: 我が脈動よ、お前は相応しい！

Taproot#058.src: ...I didn't think you would be able to help, but I had to ask. So...was this for nothing?
Taproot#058.dst: …助けになるとは思ってなかったけど、頼まずにはいられなかった。じゃあ…全部無駄だったの？
Taproot#058.speaker: Lari

Taproot#059.src: Wait...y-you...had a choice? He gave you the choice too?! A-Already?!
Taproot#059.dst: 待って…あ、あなたにも…選択が？あの方があなたにも？も、もう？！
Taproot#059.speaker: Lari

Taproot#060.src: Wh- I don't understand! You...you just arrived to Gavel! You haven't seen its decline! Felt its pain!
Taproot#060.dst: な…わからない！あなたは…Gavel に来たばかりじゃない！衰退も見てない！痛みも感じてない！
Taproot#060.speaker: Lari

Taproot#061.src: What did you do?! The gate is opening? YOU did this?! I know your heart is in the right place, but you're a stranger to this land!
Taproot#061.dst: 何をしたの？！門が開いてる？「あなた」が？！善意なのは分かる、でもあなたはこの地のよそ者なのよ！
Taproot#061.speaker: Lari

Taproot#062.src: I...I...rrrgh... AAAAGH!! This isn't fair!! I've worked for decades and the light just...throws me to the wayside?!
Taproot#062.dst: わ…私…ううう… ああああ！！不公平よ！！何十年も尽くしたのに、光は私を…見捨てるの？！
Taproot#062.speaker: Lari

Taproot#064.src: My pulse, you must leave her be. Her heart's emotions have overpowered her mind's judgement. She must learn to separate them as you have.
Taproot#064.dst: 我が脈動よ、彼女は放っておけ。心の感情が頭の判断を上回ってしまった。お前のように両者を分けることを学ばねばならぬ。

Taproot#065.src: Please... You can't DO this to me!!
Taproot#065.dst: お願い… こんな仕打ち、ひどい！！
Taproot#065.speaker: Lari

Taproot#066.src: Why do you want this human to enter the Taproot?! What's special about them, what's their connection? What have they done that I haven't?! Tell me, please! Let me be useful!!
Taproot#066.dst: どうしてこの人間を Taproot に入れたいの？！何が特別なの、何の繋がりが？私にできなかった何をしたの？！教えて、お願い！役に立たせて！！
Taproot#066.speaker: Lari

Taproot#068.dst: 奇妙な領域を探索する

Taproot#069.src: Your heartbeat beats in time with mine. Your mind is unclouded, despite the fury you have been steeped in. My pulse, you are needed.
Taproot#069.dst: お前の鼓動は我が鼓動と拍を合わせる。怒りに浸されてなお、お前の心は曇らぬ。我が脈動よ、お前が必要だ。

Taproot#070.src: Your eyes cannot see the scope of the realms. You must allow me to shed light upon them- You must see the connections.
Taproot#070.dst: お前の目には諸領域の広がりが見えぬ。私に光を当てさせよ。お前はその繋がりを見ねばならぬ。

Taproot#071.src: Light... Dark... We oppose. I am light. It is dark. Our places reflect this land...and it is plain- The sun is setting. Light is fading
Taproot#071.dst: 光…闇…我らは対立する。私は光。あれは闇。我らの在り方はこの地を映す…そして明白だ。日は沈み、光は消えゆく

Taproot#072.src: The land you visit warps with the slow siphoning of my light, my blood. It becomes outlandish and strange- Oppressive and alien.
Taproot#072.dst: お前が訪れる地は、我が光、我が血がゆっくり吸われるにつれ歪む。異様で奇怪に、重苦しく異質なものとなる。

Taproot#073.src: Perhaps you should try interacting with this thing?
Taproot#073.dst: これを調べてみてはどうだろう？

Taproot#074.src: As dusk approaches- As darkness spreads- My heart slows and stops. My pulse, you are needed. You shall be as one with me, and you shall see.
Taproot#074.dst: 黄昏が迫り、闇が広がり、我が心臓は緩み、止まる。我が脈動よ、お前が必要だ。お前は我と一つとなり、見るであろう。

Taproot#075.src: {p} needs life anew- A new pulse. It need you.
Taproot#075.dst: {p} には新たな命が要る。新たな脈動が。お前が要るのだ。

Taproot#077.src: Our light is synchronous! You may see what I must have you see...
Taproot#077.dst: 我らの光は同調した！見せねばならぬものを見られよう…

Taproot#078.src: Follow the road. You must witness the reason behind my trial.
Taproot#078.dst: 道をたどれ。我が試練の理由を目撃せねばならぬ。

Taproot#079.src: See my memories. The memories of the realm. See...and be enlightened.
Taproot#079.dst: 我が記憶を見よ。この領域の記憶を。見よ…そして悟れ。

Taproot#080.src: Witness it... The Equinox. Learn why you are needed, my pulse.
Taproot#080.dst: 見届けよ…The Equinox を。我が脈動よ、お前が必要な訳を知れ。

Taproot#081.dst: 見届けよ。邪なる出現を…

Taproot#082.dst: 腐朽の始まりを見届けよ。

Taproot#083.src: My light...I won't let you down!
Taproot#083.dst: 我が光よ…失望させません！
Taproot#083.speaker: Lari

Taproot#084.dst: あなた！ここにいるべきじゃない！
Taproot#084.speaker: Lari

Taproot#085.src: Wah! Back away, I don't want to hurt you!
Taproot#085.dst: わっ！下がって、傷つけたくないの！
Taproot#085.speaker: Lari

Taproot#086.src: I can do this... Orphion, lend me your voice!
Taproot#086.dst: 私ならできる…Orphion、声をお貸しください！
Taproot#086.speaker: Lari

Taproot#087.src: Return to your realm in peace!
Taproot#087.dst: 安らかに自分の領域へ帰って！
Taproot#087.speaker: Lari

Taproot#088.src: Your power is blinded by light. You cannot win!
Taproot#088.dst: あなたの力は光に目を眩まされてる。勝てないわ！
Taproot#088.speaker: Lari

Taproot#089.src: Peace, strange creature! You must be peaceful!
Taproot#089.dst: 静まって、奇妙な生き物！落ち着きなさい！
Taproot#089.speaker: Lari

Taproot#090.src: Why isn't this working? Even Orphion's voice...
Taproot#090.dst: どうして効かないの？Orphion の声でさえ…
Taproot#090.speaker: Lari

Taproot#091.src: It's scarring the land... I need to end this, quickly...
Taproot#091.dst: 大地に傷が…早く終わらせないと…
Taproot#091.speaker: Lari

Taproot#092.src: His light... This power... I can do this!
Taproot#092.dst: あの方の光…この力…私ならできる！
Taproot#092.speaker: Lari

Taproot#093.src: The embodiment of light supports me!
Taproot#093.dst: 光の化身が私を支えてる！
Taproot#093.speaker: Lari

Taproot#094.src: You cannot fight the focus of pure light!
Taproot#094.dst: 純粋な光の集中には抗えない！
Taproot#094.speaker: Lari

Taproot#095.src: Be done! I bind you with Orphion's light!
Taproot#095.dst: 終わりよ！Orphion の光で縛る！
Taproot#095.speaker: Lari

Taproot#096.dst: 待って… ど、どうして効かないの？！
Taproot#096.speaker: Lari

Taproot#097.src: Lari... A conflicted heart failed to channel my light. She refused to battle.
Taproot#097.dst: Lari… 迷える心は我が光を導けなかった。彼女は戦いを拒んだ。

Taproot#098.src: The vile intruder was weak... But every opportunity to strike, exchanged for words to the deaf.
Taproot#098.dst: 邪なる侵入者は弱かった…だが討つ好機はすべて、聾者への言葉に費やされた。

Taproot#099.src: My pulse... It pains me. Her light simply fails to shine where it is needed, and so we are here.
Taproot#099.dst: 我が脈動よ…心が痛む。彼女の光は必要な所を照らせぬ。ゆえに我らはここにいる。

Taproot#100.src: The Realm of Light needs life anew- A new pulse. It needs you.
Taproot#100.dst: 光の領域には新たな命が要る。新たな脈動が。お前が要るのだ。

Taproot#101.src: Talk to Lari outside the Taproot gate.
Taproot#101.dst: Taproot の門の外で Lari と話す。

Taproot#102.src: I... I...hope you'll forgive me, {u}. My anger wasn't with you. I...j-just...
Taproot#102.dst: 私…許してくれるといいけど、{u}。怒ってたのはあなたにじゃないの。私…た、ただ…
Taproot#102.speaker: Lari

Taproot#103.src: I work for untold years, trying to save this province, to save a Realm... All to so little avail. To the sound of silence from the one I'm trying to help.
Taproot#103.dst: 数え切れない年月、この地方を、ひとつの領域を救おうとしてきた…ほとんど実を結ばずに。助けたい相手からは沈黙だけ。
Taproot#103.speaker: Lari

Taproot#104.src: And then, you appear, and... I still haven't ever been in there. I'd...I'd ask what it was like, but it's...probably private, right?
Taproot#104.dst: そこにあなたが現れて…私はまだ一度も中に入ったことがない。どんな所か聞きたいけど…きっと秘密よね？
Taproot#104.speaker: Lari

Taproot#105.src: At...at least I have an ally now, r-right? But...I'm afraid that... N-no, it's silly, you don't need to hear me fretting.
Taproot#105.dst: せ…せめて今は仲間がいる、よ、よね？でも…怖いのは… い、いえ、馬鹿みたい。私の心配なんて聞かなくていいわ。
Taproot#105.speaker: Lari

Taproot#106.src: I... I promise I can still be useful. I'll... I'll find a way. I promise you. I'll...get out of your way, for now.
